tutorial.step1.title: Step 1: Daily Action Dice & Composure
tutorial.step1.desc: At dawn each Cycle (Day), your investigator rolls a pool of 3 to 5 six-sided dice based on current Composure (80–100% = 5 dice, 40–79% = 4 dice, <40% = 3 dice). Composure is your mental stamina and resilience against Durban's underworld.
tutorial.step2.title: Step 2: Assigning Dice to Action Slots
tutorial.step2.desc: Hold or click a die from your bottom dock, then click an Action Slot on any unlocked map node. Rolls resolve deterministically: Die Value + Stat Modifier + Stage 6 Blackout Modifier + Hostile Turf Penalty. Tiers preview cleanly: 6+ Clean Success, 4–5 Compromised, 1–3 Failure.
tutorial.step3.title: Step 3: Rolling Blackouts (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.desc: Eskom power rotates across Stages 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 each night. During Stage 6 Blackouts, high-tech server slots lock down unless you spend R300 on Backup Generator Diesel, but covert operations at the Port and Estates gain a +2 Roll Bonus under cover of darkness.
tutorial.step4.title: Step 4: Threat & Investigation Clocks
tutorial.step4.desc: Circular segmented clocks tick down impending catastrophes (Brigadier Mokoena's Sweep, Nandi's Wound, Izinkabi Hit Squads) and track your forensic breakthroughs (Docket #409 Audit, Phone Cracking, Berth 14 Convoy). When investigation clocks fill, climactic finale showdowns unlock.
tutorial.step5.title: Step 5: Roadblocks & Faction Perks
tutorial.step5.desc: High Precinct Heat or Threat levels trigger armed SAPS roadblock corridors between sectors. Crossing them burns 1 Die or R200 in cold drink bribes unless you possess a cloned SAPS scanner. Earn positive Faction Rep to unlock 1/day tactical abilities like Grid Manipulation and Blue-Light Escorts.
tutorial.step6.title: Step 6: Contacts, Evidence & Red-String Board
tutorial.step6.desc: Speak with local fixers and faction bosses at each node to interrogate leads, present forensic exhibits, and claim one-time favors. Press 'B' or tap 'BOARD' anytime to inspect your red-string conspiracy corkboard, tracing the money trail from City Hall to Berth 14.

slot.act_audit_docket.title: Cross-Reference Docket #409
slot.act_audit_docket.desc: Match bloodstained tanker invoices against the municipal registry.
slot.act_audit_docket.clean: You trace the payments straight to Zululand Aqua-Logistics and Pier 2.
slot.act_audit_docket.compromised: Hours of eye strain under a flickering inverter bulb yield one shell director name.
slot.act_audit_docket.failure: The ledger codes are a maze of dead ends. Your head is pounding.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.title: Rest & Patch Up Nandi
slot.act_rest_safehouse.desc: Recover Composure. Buy medical gauze to stall Nandi’s wound clock.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.clean: You clean her bandages and rest. Nandi’s fever breaks slightly.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.compromised: Rest is interrupted by police sirens echoing down Queen Street.
slot.act_rest_safehouse.failure: Restless sleep full of nightmares about Mokoena’s TRT squads.
slot.act_call_maharaj.title: Call Dr. Maharaj (Off-the-Books Surgeon)
slot.act_call_maharaj.desc: Bring in a private trauma surgeon to extract the bullet and stabilize Nandi.
slot.act_call_maharaj.clean: Dr. Maharaj extracts the bullet fragment cleanly. Nandi is out of danger.
slot.act_call_maharaj.compromised: The surgery is rough under flashlight beams, but Nandi’s vitals stabilize.
slot.act_call_maharaj.failure: Dr. Maharaj gets spooked by a patrol van outside and only leaves antibiotics.
slot.act_rank_muscle.title: Enforce Route Tariffs
slot.act_rank_muscle.desc: Shake down pirate operators along the Umgeni corridor for Bra Bheki.
slot.act_rank_muscle.clean: Pirate drivers pay up without drawing weapons. Bra Bheki nods in respect.
slot.act_rank_muscle.compromised: A wrench catches your shoulder in the scuffle, but you walk away with cash.
slot.act_rank_muscle.failure: Shots fired near the rank entrance. Metro police sirens wail in the distance.
slot.act_taxi_intel.title: Tap the Driver Network
slot.act_taxi_intel.desc: Pay rank marshals to track unmarked TRT bakkies and roadblocks.
slot.act_taxi_intel.clean: Taxi drivers blanket the radio channels with Mokoena’s exact patrol routes.
slot.act_taxi_intel.compromised: Scattered intel from drivers who only saw half the convoy.
slot.act_taxi_intel.failure: You pay for intel that turns out to be useless tavern gossip.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.title: Bribe the Evidence Clerk
slot.act_bribe_clerk.desc: Slip a corrupt warrant officer cash to pull ballistic reports from the N2 heist.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.clean: The clerk slides ballistic matching files across the precinct canteen table.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.compromised: You get partial incident logs before internal affairs walks past.
slot.act_bribe_clerk.failure: The clerk takes your cash and reports you to Mokoena’s duty sergeant.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.title: Walk Into Mokoena’s Office
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.desc: Bluff your former commander face-to-face about why Nandi is on the BOLO list.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.clean: Mokoena buys your cover story and advances you R3,000 retainer to bring him Docket #409.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.compromised: Mokoena stares you down across his mahogany desk. You buy yourself 24 hours.
slot.act_bluff_mokoena.failure: Mokoena smells a rat immediately. TRT officers escort you out at gunpoint.
slot.act_audit_tenders.title: Infiltrate Municipal Registry
slot.act_audit_tenders.desc: Pose as a compliance officer to trace Zululand Aqua-Logistics shell accounts.
slot.act_audit_tenders.clean: You extract signed copies of Ma-Sibi’s emergency tanker embezzlement scheme.
slot.act_audit_tenders.compromised: Security almost catches you in the registry archive, but you escape with key receipts.
slot.act_audit_tenders.failure: Alarms trigger on the 4th floor. You flee empty-handed.
slot.act_masibi_deal.title: Pitch a Deal to Ma-Sibi's Chief of Staff
slot.act_masibi_deal.desc: Offer to bury the auditor’s ledger before the municipal coalition vote in exchange for City Hall protection and Grid Manipulation.
slot.act_masibi_deal.clean: Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff wires R5,000 hush money and gives you a direct line to the municipal grid control room.
slot.act_masibi_deal.compromised: The Chief of Staff agrees to a tentative truce, unlocking municipal grid access.
slot.act_masibi_deal.failure: Mayoral VIP bodyguards throw you out of the 4th-floor suite and alert Central Precinct.
slot.act_crack_phone.title: Crack Auditor's Handset
slot.act_crack_phone.desc: Bypass biometric encryption on the dead auditor’s phone.
slot.act_crack_phone.clean: Sparks cracks a layer of encryption. Voice notes from Pier 2 begin downloading.
slot.act_crack_phone.compromised: Security triggers a remote wipe warning, but Sparks holds the firewall.
slot.act_crack_phone.failure: A security ping alerts Abasanta cyber-cleaners before Sparks pulls the cable.
slot.act_clone_transponder.title: Clone SAPS Radio Frequencies
slot.act_clone_transponder.desc: Build an intercept scanner to monitor TRT dispatch and bypass SAPS roadblocks.
slot.act_clone_transponder.clean: You pocket the cloned SAPS scanner—you can now hear and bypass every roadblock in real time.
slot.act_clone_transponder.compromised: Static-heavy radio scanner works well enough to slip past police cordons.
slot.act_clone_transponder.failure: You fry the soldering board and lose R500 in spare parts.
slot.act_recon_berth14.title: Recon Berth 14 Container Drop
slot.act_recon_berth14.desc: Photograph chemical precursor drums being loaded into municipal tankers.
slot.act_recon_berth14.clean: Crisp photos of Mokoena shaking hands with Zuko’s dock supervisor.
slot.act_recon_berth14.compromised: Maritime guards spot your flashlight beam; you flee into the container stacks.
slot.act_recon_berth14.failure: Cartel enforcers corner you behind a forklift; you barely escape the gate.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.title: [FINALE] Confront the Berth 14 Convoy
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.desc: Move in on the midnight tanker drop to execute the Vigilante ambush or negotiate the Kingpin compact at The Glass House.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.clean: You take position above Berth 14 as the municipal water tankers pull alongside Zuko’s crane.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.compromi: You slip past the perimeter fence under pouring rain as the convoy engines roar to life.
slot.act_trigger_berth14_finale.failure: Port security dogs force you back; the shipment window is nearly here.
slot.act_handover_dockets.title: Brief Colonel van der Merwe
slot.act_handover_dockets.desc: Hand over certified copies of Docket #409 to the clean Hawks investigators.
slot.act_handover_dockets.clean: Van der Merwe locks the file in a physical safe. The Hawks are opening an official dossier.
slot.act_handover_dockets.compromised: Van der Merwe warns you that Mokoena has moles inside the Hawks archives.
slot.act_handover_dockets.failure: Van der Merwe is out on a raid; you leave the documents with a nervous desk sergeant.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.ti: [FINALE] Launch the National Broadcast & Witness Extraction
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.de: Seal the archive blast doors and transmit the Berth 14 evidence to The Daily Veld to trigger the Act 1 Climax.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.cl: Van der Merwe’s encrypted uplink connects to The Daily Veld newsroom as midnight strikes at Berth 14.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.co: The uplink holds despite TRT signal jammers outside the magistrate court.
slot.act_trigger_whistleblower_finale.fa: Static scrambles the transmission—the midnight deadline at Berth 14 is closing fast.

event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.title: Blue Lights in the Alley
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.speaker: Sergeant Dlamini
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p1: Heavy combat boots thunder up the concrete stairwell of the Mercury Arcade. Through the slatted blinds, three unmarked Volkswagen Golf GTIs and a Nyala armoured carrier block both ends of the street.
event.evt_trt_safehouse_raid.p2: A rifle butt hammers your steel security gate. "Hawks Warrant Officer! Open the gate or we blow the hinges! Brigadier Mokoena wants his docket back!"
choice.choice_roof_escape.label: Slip Across the Arcade Tin Roofs
choice.choice_roof_escape.desc: Grab Nandi and the docket, climb through the skylight, and drop into the taxi rank alley.
choice.choice_roof_escape.log: You scramble across rusted corrugated iron in the rain. TRT breaches an empty flat.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.label: Pass a Brown Envelope Through the Bars (R1,200)
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.desc: Sergeant Dlamini has gambling debts at Greyville. Pay him to report that the flat was vacant.
choice.choice_pay_dlamini.log: Dlamini weighs the cash, barks into his radio that the tip was cold, and pulls his squad back.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.label: Surrender Decoy Pages & Take a Beating
choice.choice_burn_decoy.desc: Hide the genuine ledger pages under the floorboards and take the TRT shakedown.
choice.choice_burn_decoy.log: Dlamini leaves you bruised on the linoleum floor, taking fake annexures back to Central Precinct.
event.evt_nandi_critical.title: Septic Shock
event.evt_nandi_critical.speaker: Constable Nandi
event.evt_nandi_critical.p1: Nandi is shivering violently under a sweat-soaked blanket. The grazing bullet wound along her ribs has turned an angry, dark purple, and she is slipping in and out of consciousness.
event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: If you take her to Addington or Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospital, the gunshot register will alert Brigadier Mokoena within twenty minutes.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.label: Pay Dr. Maharaj for Emergency Surgery (R1,500)
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.desc: Call the off-the-books surgeon with a portable cauterizer and IV antibiotics.
choice.choice_emergency_maharaj.log: Dr. Maharaj extracts the brass jacket fragments and stabilizes Nandi before dawn.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.label: Call Colonel van der Merwe for Safe-House Medics
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.desc: Requires Hawks trust. Hand Nandi over to the Old Archive task force for covert medical care.
choice.choice_hawks_extraction.log: Van der Merwe smuggles Nandi out in a laundry van to a rural safe clinic.
choice.choice_public_hospital.label: Dump Her at the State Trauma Ward & Run
choice.choice_public_hospital.desc: Saves her life for free, but Mokoena immediately locks onto your trail.
choice.choice_public_hospital.log: Doctors stabilize Nandi, but TRT detectives surround the trauma ward within the hour.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.title: Operation Shanela Lockdown
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.speaker: Metro Police Dispatch
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p1: Sirens echo between the high-rises. Floodlights and orange cones seal off the main CBD intersections as SAPS and Metro Police mount a high-density stop-and-search cordon.
event.evt_shanela_roadblock.p2: Every minibus, courier bike, and pedestrian is being searched for unlicensed firearms and stolen dockets.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.label: Ride in Bra Bheki’s VIP Kombi Convoy
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.desc: Use your Street Syndicate standing to slip past the cordon in an untouchable association vehicle.
choice.choice_taxi_smuggle.log: The Metro cops wave Bra Bheki’s tinted Quantum straight through without checking IDs.
choice.choice_spot_fine.label: Pay "Cold Drink" Money at the Cordon (R600)
choice.choice_spot_fine.desc: Fold three R200 notes inside your driver’s license and keep your head down.
choice.choice_spot_fine.log: The officer pockets the notes, taps your roof, and waves you through the cones.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.label: Wait it Out in the Stormwater Culverts
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.desc: Spend hours wading through ankle-deep runoff beneath the N2 until the roadblock packs up.
choice.choice_drainage_tunnels.log: You emerge soaked and exhausted at dawn, but your trail is cold.
event.evt_docket_decoded.title: The Water-Tanker Pipeline
event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: You lay the bloodstained pages of Docket #409 across your table under the inverter lamp. The numbers finally click into place.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" billed City Hall R400 million to deliver emergency water to dry northern townships. Except the GPS logs show those municipal tankers never went to the townships—they drove straight from Pier 2 Cold Storage to industrial warehouses outside town, escorted by Brigadier Mokoena’s TRT vans.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: Councillor Ma-Sibi isn’t just stealing water money. Her municipal tankers are transporting liquid chemical precursors for Zuko Ndlovu’s methamphetamine super-labs.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.label: Pin City Hall and Pier 2 to the Map
choice.choice_unlock_leads.desc: Unlocks City Hall Annex (N4) and Pier 2 Cold Storage (N6) for direct investigation or blackmail.
choice.choice_unlock_leads.log: Breakthrough: City Hall Annex and Pier 2 Cold Storage are now unlocked on your district map.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.title: Voice Note from Berth 14
event.evt_phone_decrypted.speaker: Sparks
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p1: Sparks exhales a cloud of vape smoke as the dead auditor’s phone finally bypasses its biometric lock. Inside a hidden vault folder sits an encrypted audio recording and a shipping manifest for tonight.
event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: On the recording, Brigadier Mokoena’s gravel voice is unmistakable: "Clear the N2 weighbridge at midnight. Zuko’s container drops at Berth 14, and anyone from the Hawks who sniffs around gets buried in a mine shaft."
choice.choice_take_manifest.label: Download the Berth 14 Manifest & Hawks Contact
choice.choice_take_manifest.desc: Unlocks The Old Archive Basement (N7) and gives you hard leverage over Mokoena and Zuko.
choice.choice_take_manifest.log: You pocket the cloned drive. Colonel van der Merwe’s basement archive is now accessible.
event.evt_climax_berth14.title: Midnight at Berth 14: The Final Play
event.evt_climax_berth14.speaker: Port Control & Tactical Dispatch
event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Rain sheets sideways across the Natal Port Channel as the giant gantry cranes of Pier 2 loom out of the mist. Below Berth 14, three municipal water tankers idly wait beside Zuko Ndlovu’s refrigerated shipping containers, flanked by Brigadier Mokoena’s blue-light TRT Nyalas.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Your time is up. Whether you arrived here with decoded treasury ledgers, the auditor’s encrypted voice notes, or sheer street muscle, you only have one shot to play your hand before the convoy rolls out onto the N2 highway.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.label: [VIGILANTE PATH] Signal Bra Bheki’s Izinkabi & Torch the Convoy
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.desc: Spark an all-out harbour turf war between the Queen Street Syndicate and Mokoena’s TRT squads, burn the chemical tankers, and hijack R450,000 in cartel bearer cash.
choice.climax_choice_vigilante.log: Tracer rounds ignite the Pier 2 precursor drums as you breach the command van and vanish into the blackout with the cartel’s bearer cash.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.label: [WHISTLEBLOWER PATH] Broadcast the Dossier to The Daily Veld & Hawks
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.desc: Transmit the audited water-tanker ledger and Mokoena’s audio recording nationwide while Colonel van der Merwe extracts Constable Nandi into witness protection.
choice.climax_choice_whistleblower.log: By 06:00 AM, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice note is playing on every radio station in South Africa and Treasury freezes Ma-Sibi’s R400m tender.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.label: [KINGPIN PATH] Ascend to The Glass House & Demand 20% of the Pipeline
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.desc: Meet Zuko Ndlovu, Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff, and Brigadier Mokoena atop the grain silos. Burn Docket #409 yourself in exchange for reinstatement and a syndicate partnership.
choice.climax_choice_kingpin.log: You drop Docket #409 into the brazier atop The Glass House. Your suspension is wiped, and your first R80,000 tanker retainer clears before dawn.
choice.climax_choice_captured.label: [NO LEVERAGE] Caught in the Pier 2 Perimeter Dragnet
choice.climax_choice_captured.desc: Without the decoded ledger or the decrypted Berth 14 manifest, Mokoena’s TRT spotters box you in before you can reach the quay.
choice.climax_choice_captured.log: Four unmarked TRT Golf GTIs cut off your escape in the rain. Docket #409 is seized before sunrise.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.title: Blackout Paranoia: Nervous Collapse
event.evt_composure_breakdown.speaker: Internal Monologue
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p1: Your hands won’t stop shaking. Between the diesel generator fumes, the wail of sirens down Queen Street, and six months of watching your own back, your vision tunnels into static.
event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: You slump against the damp concrete stairwell of the Mercury Arcade, struggling to catch your breath. If you don’t steady your nerves right now, you’re going to make a fatal mistake.
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.label: Score Black-Market Amphetamines at the Arcade Kiosk (R500)
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.desc: Forces your focus back online immediately (+45% Composure), though the dealer talks (+1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_stimulants.log: Bitter chemical tablets shock your nervous system back into focus (+45% Composure, +1 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.labe: Call Colonel van der Merwe’s Field Medic (Hawks Rep >= 1)
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.desc: Use your Hawks holdout trust for a clean adrenaline shot and counter-surveillance watch (+50% Composure).
choice.choice_breakdown_hawks_medic.log: A retired Hawks paramedic patches you up in the back of an unmarked van (+50% Composure, -1 Sweep).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.label: Pass Out on the Safehouse Floor Until the Shaking Stops
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.desc: Recovers +35% Composure for free, but you lose precious hours while Mokoena’s net tightens (+1 Sweep, +1 Nandi’s Wound).
choice.choice_breakdown_passout.log: You wake up hours later on the cold linoleum floor (+35% Composure, but Threat Clocks advance).
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.title: Encrypted Wire: The 4th-Floor Olive Branch
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.speaker: Councillor Ma-Sibi's Chief of Staff
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p1: As the morning taxis begin honking along Queen Street, your burner handset vibrates with an unindexed Signal message from City Hall’s 4th Floor.
event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. We know Constable Nandi brought you Mandla Sithole’s paperwork. Nobody at City Hall wants another funeral. Slow down your audit today, and an R800 municipal consulting retainer will be dropped in your mailbox within the hour."
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.lab: Accept the R800 "Consulting Retainer" & Play Along
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.des: Pocket R800 and gain +1 City Hall Rep, but costs -10% Composure as you stomach the corruption.
choice.choice_masibi_accept_retainer.log: A courier drops a brown municipal envelope with R800 cash at your arcade postbox (+R800, +1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.label: Back-Trace the Burner Message Header (WIRE >= 1)
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.desc: Use your signals skill to strip the metadata from the Chief of Staff’s message (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_trace_packet.log: You capture the municipal server certificate from the message header (+1 Crack Auditor’s Handset).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.label: Snap the Burner SIM in Half & Keep Digging
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.desc: Refuse to be bought (+10% Composure, +1 Hawks Rep, -1 City Hall Rep).
choice.choice_masibi_burn_sim.log: You snap the SIM card in half and toss it into the rain gutter (+10% Composure, +1 Hawks Rep).
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.title: Morning Dispatch: Umgeni Feeder Cable Stripped
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.location: West Street & Umgeni Corridor • Cycle 3 Dawn
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p1: Thick black smoke rises from the Umgeni substation at dawn. A copper-theft syndicate stripped three high-voltage feeder cables overnight, throwing the CBD traffic lights into chaos.
event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Bra Bheki’s route marshals have taken over the intersections with whistles and sjamboks, while SAPS patrol vans are stuck gridlocked two blocks away.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.label: Help Bra Bheki’s Marshals Reroute the Morning Rank
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.desc: Earn R500 cut from the rank marshals and +1 Street Syndicate standing.
choice.choice_cable_help_bheki.log: You clear the delivery lane for Bra Bheki’s Quantums and pocket R500 (+R500, +1 Street Syndicate Rep).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.label: Exploit the Grid Surge to Scrub Precinct ANPR Cameras
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.desc: Use the substation voltage drop to wipe license-plate hits (-2 Precinct Heat).
choice.choice_cable_scrub_cctv.log: The substation surge corrupts Central Precinct’s last 24 hours of street camera logs (-2 Precinct Heat).
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.title: Urgent Wire: MV Southern Cross Docking at Berth 14
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: A horn blasts across the harbour mist as the container ship MV Southern Cross clears the breakwater. Your encrypted radio crackles with Colonel van der Merwe’s voice.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Listen carefully. Zuko Ndlovu’s chemical drums are being offloaded at Berth 14 tonight, and Mokoena’s TRT vans are already staging at the weighbridge. Make sure you hold either the Decoded Tanker Ledger or the Berth 14 Manifest before midnight strikes."
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.label: Check Your Evidence Dossier & Prepare for Tonight
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.desc: Steels your nerves for the final cycle (+15% Composure).
choice.choice_port_lock_and_load.log: The MV Southern Cross is in port. Tonight is the final countdown for Berth 14 (+15% Composure).
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.title: Crossfire on the M4 Flyover
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.speaker: Out-of-Province Izinkabi
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p1: Two unlicensed white double-cab bakkies box your sedan against the concrete barrier of the M4 coastal flyover. Muzzle flashes light up the rain as automatic rifle fire spiders across your windscreen.
event.evt_act2_izinkabi_ambush.p2: Zuko and Brigadier Mokoena have activated their out-of-province contract killers to make sure you never reach the High Court witness stand.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.label: Ram the Lead Bakkie & Return Fire (STREET >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.desc: Smash through the roadblock with tactical precision (-2 Hit Squad, -10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ram.log: You pit-maneuver the lead bakkie into the guardrail and vanish into the northern township lanes (Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.label: Wire R900 via Bra Bheki’s Rank Marshals to Call Off the Contract
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.desc: Use syndicate back-channels and R900 cash to buy off the gunmen.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_payoff.log: A single phone call from Queen Street pulls the gunmen off your tail (-R900, Hit Squad clock reset).
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.label: Bail Out Into the Stormwater Ravine
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.desc: Survive with heavy bruising (-30% Composure, +1 Contempt Warrant), but escape the kill-zone.
choice.choice_act2_ambush_ditch.log: Your car is riddled with bullets as you roll down the flooded embankment (-30% Composure, Hit Squad reset).
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.title: State Security Contempt Warrant
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.speaker: Advocate Vermeulen
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p1: Armed sheriffs and State Security agents surround you on the marble steps of the High Court, waving a sealed detention order signed under the Protection of State Information Act.
event.evt_act2_contempt_arrest.p2: "You are hereby placed under preventive custody for unlawful possession of classified municipal infrastructure records."
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.label: Cite Section 205 Whistleblower Immunity (DOCKETS >= 2)
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.desc: Destroy the defective warrant in open court (+1 Hawks Rep, resets Contempt Warrant).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_quash.log: Judge Khumalo quashes the arrest warrant from the bench as television cameras roll (Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.label: Post R800 Emergency Senior Counsel Bail
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.desc: Pay R800 legal retainer to stay out of the holding cells.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_bail.log: Your emergency counsel secures an interim interdict keeping you on the street (-R800, Contempt Warrant reset).
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.label: Slip Out Through the Magistrates’ Basement Tunnel
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.desc: Avoid detention but lose -25% Composure and +1 Hit Squad heat.
choice.choice_act2_contempt_flee.log: You bolt through the subterranean archive tunnel before the handcuffs click (-25% Composure, +1 Hit Squad).
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.title: Breakthrough: The Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.location: High Court Evidence Vault • Encrypted Uplink
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.speaker: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p1: The printer in Colonel van der Merwe’s locked chamber hums to life, spitting out the unredacted DIFC Dubai beneficial-ownership register for Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
event.evt_act2_trust_unmasked.p2: There it is in black and white: Zuko Ndlovu (45%), Councillor Ma-Sibi (30%), and Brigadier Titus Mokoena (25%)—alongside a paid charter escrow for a Gulfstream G550 (Flight ZS-900) waiting at King Shaka Hangar 7 and property deeds to Lot 44 in the Midlands.
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.labe: Certify the Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed & Unlock Inland Leads
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.desc: Adds Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed to your inventory and unlocks Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) & King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_trust_deed.log: Secured Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed! Unlocked Midlands Citrus Estate (N11) & King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.title: Breakthrough: Midlands Packhouse Telemetry
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.speaker: Bra Bheki Sithole
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p1: Sparks’ decoded GPS plot overlays cleanly onto the provincial agricultural map. Every municipal water tanker billed to the dry northern townships actually diverted up the N3 highway to Lot 44: the Hydroponic Citrus Estate.
event.evt_act2_lab_telemetry.p2: Even better, the cargo manifests show 1.8 metric tons of finished crystal product loaded into export citrus pallets bound for Hangar 7 at King Shaka International Airport tonight.
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.label: Log Midlands Batch Telemetry & Unlock Inland Targets
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.desc: Adds Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry to your inventory and unlocks Hydroponic Citrus Estate (N11) & King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
choice.choice_act2_claim_telemetry.log: Secured Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry! Unlocked Midlands Citrus Estate (N11) & King Shaka Cargo Apron (N12).
event.evt_act2_morning_commission_leak.t: Morning Dispatch: Panic on Umhlanga Ridge
event.evt_act2_morning_commission_leak.p: Morning newspapers across KwaZulu-Natal carry banner headlines from the Commission of Inquiry. On Umhlanga Ridge, paper shredders are working overtime as shell-company directors scramble to book flights out of King Shaka.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.la: Brief the Court Press Gallery (+1 Trace Trust, +1 Contempt)
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.de: Keep the public spotlight burning on Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
choice.choice_act2_morning_press_pack.lo: Your anonymous press packet forces the bank’s directors onto the back foot (+1 Trace Trust).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.label: Rotate Safehouse Vehicles & Keep Nandi Hidden
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.desc: Throw Zuko’s spotters off your trail (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
choice.choice_act2_morning_lay_low.log: You swap plates in the basement garage, leaving the hit squad circling an empty hotel (-1 Hit Squad, +10% Composure).
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.title: Wheels Up at Hangar 7: The Final Reckoning
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.speaker: Zuko Ndlovu, Cllr. Ma-Sibi & Brig. Mokoena
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Sheets of warm coastal rain lash the floodlit concrete of Hangar 7. The twin Rolls-Royce turbines of Gulfstream ZS-900 scream at idle as forklift crews load the final pallets of bearer bonds and diplomatic pouches into the hold.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: At the foot of the airstairs stand all three architects of eThekwini-Gold’s capture: Zuko Ndlovu in his spotless trench coat, Councillor Ma-Sibi clutching her diplomatic passport, and Brigadier Mokoena with his service rifle aimed across the wet tarmac.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Five minutes to wheels-up, Warrant Officer," Zuko calls over the jet wash. "Decide what kind of country you’re waking up in tomorrow."
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.labe: [CONSTITUTIONAL RECKONING] Execute the High Court Arrest Warrants & Ground ZS-900
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.desc: Requires Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed or Super-Lab Telemetry. Lead Col. van der Merwe’s Hawks unit onto the tarmac and arrest all three on live national television.
choice.choice_act2_ending_reckoning.log: Hawks armoured vehicles lock the runway as you serve the High Court indictment at gunpoint.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.lab: [DRY-TAP UPRISING] Seize the Tanker Fleet & Hand the Midlands Millions to the Townships
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.des: Requires Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed or Super-Lab Telemetry. Let Bra Bheki’s strike marshals storm Hangar 7, expropriate the syndicate’s R400m escrow, and turn the water valves back on.
choice.choice_act2_ending_revolution.log: Hundreds of minibus taxis and municipal tankers breach the perimeter fence, seizing the cartel’s fortune for the dry wards.
choice.choice_act2_ending_syndicate_stat: [THE GHOST SOVEREIGN] Wave Flight ZS-900 Through in Exchange for the Master Trust Keys
Requires Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed or Super-Lab Telemetry. Let the politicians flee to Dubai while you inherit sole command of the province’s shadow logistics empire.
Zuko tosses you the master cryptographic key from the airstairs as ZS-900 hurtles down the runway into the storm.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.label: [UNARMED ON THE APRON] Confront the Triumvirate Without Certified Proof
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.desc: If you arrived at Hangar 7 without the Trust Deed or Super-Lab Telemetry, Mokoena’s bodyguards close the hangar doors behind you.
choice.choice_act2_ending_vanished.log: Without certified High Court exhibits, the hangar floodlights cut out and the jet wash drowns out your final shot.
ending.ending_vigilante.title: The Harbour Fire
ending.ending_vigilante.subtitle: Pier 2 Container Terminal • 01:40 AM (Stage 6 Blackout)
ending.ending_vigilante.quote: "When the law is bought and the state is captured, the only justice left is the match you strike in the dark."
ending.ending_vigilante.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: As turf war spreads to the northern townships, a national commission of inquiry arrives from Pretoria—and both Zuko and Mokoena want you silenced before you testify.
ending.ending_whistleblower.title: Front Page of The Daily Veld
ending.ending_whistleblower.subtitle: Old Archive Sub-Basement & National Broadcast • 06:00 AM
ending.ending_whistleblower.quote: "They can burn a paper docket and buy a magistrate, but they cannot put four hundred million Rand back in the dark once the whole country hears the tape."
ending.ending_whistleblower.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: With Mokoena on the run as a rogue warlord and Nandi preparing to testify at the High Court, you must keep your star witness alive for 72 hours.
ending.ending_kingpin.title: Twenty Percent of the Taps
ending.ending_kingpin.subtitle: Penthouse Atop the Harbour Grain Silos • Midnight
ending.ending_kingpin.quote: "In eThekwini-Gold, nobody beats the machine. You either get crushed beneath the tankers, or you buy a seat at the valve."
ending.ending_kingpin.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: Constable Nandi refuses your blood money and disappears into the townships with a hidden photocopy of the docket—forcing you to hunt down your own former partner.
ending.ending_captured.title: Buried in Shaft 9
ending.ending_captured.subtitle: Abandoned Gold & Coal Workings Outside Town • Pre-Dawn
ending.ending_captured.quote: "The city doesn’t need a trial when a Stage 6 blackout and an unmarked bakkie do the job before sunrise."
ending.ending_captured.hook: TRY ANOTHER TIMELINE: Manage your Composure, use the Queen Street taxi network to bleed off Mokoena’s Sweep clock, and unlock Pier 2 before the dragnet closes.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.title: Live on National Television
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.subtitle: King Shaka Hangar 7 & High Court Steps • Sunrise
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "For the first time in twenty years, the blue-light sirens weren’t clearing traffic for the VIPs—they were taking them in handcuffs."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: CAMPAIGN COMPLETE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): You survived the blackouts, unmasked the Sovereign Pearl conspiracy, and brought eThekwini-Gold’s untouchables to justice.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.title: The People's Convoy
ending.ending_act2_revolution.subtitle: Northern Township Reservoir & Hangar 7 • Dawn
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "They stole the water and sold us the drought. Tonight we took back the trucks, the taps, and the bank account."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: CAMPAIGN COMPLETE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): You broke the state-capture syndicate from the ground up and returned eThekwini-Gold’s lifeblood to its people.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.title: Chairman of the Board
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Empires don’t fall when the king boards a plane. They just change signatures on the trust deed."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: CAMPAIGN COMPLETE (ACT 1 + ACT 2): You outmaneuvered every faction in eThekwini-Gold and claimed the throne of the shadow state.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.title: Sealed for Fifty Years
ending.ending_act2_vanished.subtitle: King Shaka Cargo Apron • 01:15 AM
ending.ending_act2_vanished.quote: "By order of the Chairperson, Exhibit 409-B is hereby classified under National Key Points regulations."
ending.ending_act2_vanished.hook: TRY ACT 2 AGAIN: Complete either the "Trace Sovereign Pearl Trust" clock (at The Ridge or High Court) or the "Synthesize Super-Lab Telemetry" clock (at Northern Township Depot) before intercepting Flight ZS-900!
bg.forensic_hawk.title: The Paper-Trail Auditor
bg.forensic_hawk.tagline: You follow the Rands through shell companies and municipal tenders.
bg.forensic_hawk.desc: Brigadier Mokoena framed you when your audit of municipal water-tanker contracts got too close to City Hall. You cannot fight a hit squad head-on, but give you a ledger and a magistrate clerk, and you can bring down an empire.
bg.trt_breacher.title: The Burned Enforcer
bg.trt_breacher.tagline: You know how Mokoena’s hit squads operate because you used to lead one.
bg.trt_breacher.desc: You kicked down doors from KwaMashu to the Point until you refused an order to stage a shootout at Pier 2. Every taxi boss and station commander knows your face—and respects your trigger discipline.
bg.crime_intel.title: The Ghost Wiretapper
bg.crime_intel.tagline: Cell-tower dumps, cloned transponders, and off-the-record blackmail.
bg.crime_intel.desc: You lived in the back of an unmarked panel van listening to cartel bosses whisper to city councillors. When someone wiped the central server and pinned the leak on you, you kept backup drives hidden across the CBD.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: At two in the morning, the municipal grid dies with a heavy metallic clunk from the substation down on Queen Street. The ceiling fan slows to a halt. Outside your slatted windows, the humid coastal rain hammers the corrugated tin roofs of the Mercury Arcade, lit only by the amber glow of a spaza shop’s diesel generator across the alley.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: On your desk sits a half-empty bottle of cane spirits and the suspension letter signed by Brigadier Titus Mokoena six months ago.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Then comes the sound—not on the downstairs buzzer, but three frantic, wet slams against your welded steel Trellidor gate at the top of the fire escape. Before you reach for the 9mm Parabellum under your mattress, remember who you were before Mokoena buried your career:
popt.pick_forensic.label: Select Background: The Paper-Trail Auditor (+2 Dockets, +1 Influence)
popt.pick_breacher.label: Select Background: The Burned Enforcer (+2 Street, +1 Dockets)
popt.pick_intel.label: Select Background: The Ghost Wiretapper (+2 Wire, +1 Influence)
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: You rack the slide of your Z88 and step to the side of the doorframe. Through the peephole, the emergency rechargeable bulb flickers over a soaked blue SAPS windbreaker.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: It’s Constable Nandi—the only rookie in the precinct who refused to sign Mokoena’s false affidavit against you. She is clutching her left ribs, dark blood seeping between her fingers, with a heavy brown manila docket and a cracked smartphone wedged under her arm.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." she gasps, eyes darting toward the stairwell shadow. "Open the gate. Please. Mokoena’s TRT vans just swept past the taxi rank. If my radio transponder is still pinging, they’re two blocks behind me."
popt.opt_wire_kill_radio.label: [WIRE] Rip the battery and GPS module out of her SAPS handset first
popt.opt_street_clear_alley.label: [STREET] Check the alley sightlines, haul her inside, and padlock the gate
popt.opt_standard_pull_in.label: Unlock the Trellidor and get her onto the kitchen floor
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: You press a clean towel against her side. A 9mm hollow-point grazed her lower ribcage—deep enough to bleed steadily, too dangerous to stitch up at a state hospital where police clerks log every gunshot victim.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: Nandi shoves Docket #409 and a blood-smeared smartphone into your hands. "We responded to a Cash-in-Transit heist on the N2 south ramp at midnight. The G4S van was blown open with commercial C4, Warrant. Only there weren’t any cash cassettes inside."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: She swallows hard, trembling. "There was a dead municipal auditor handcuffed to the floor cages, and this ledger. Four hundred million Rand in emergency water-tanker tenders routed through Councillor Ma-Sibi’s office straight to Zuko Ndlovu’s port warehouses. When my partner tried to log it over dispatch, Brigadier Mokoena pulled up in an unmarked TRT bakkie... and shot him in the chest."
popt.opt_dockets_inspect.label: [DOCKETS] Flip open Docket #409 and check the treasury authorisation stamps
popt.opt_influence_calm_nandi.label: [INFLUENCE] "Breathe, Nandi. Mokoena doesn’t know this flat exists. You’re alive."
popt.opt_ask_phone.label: "Whose phone is this? And who else saw you escape the N2?"
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.time: 05:45 AM // FIRST LIGHT OVER THE HARBOUR
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: Nandi passes out on your sofa as the grey coastal dawn bleeds through the blinds. Outside, the first minibus taxis begin honking down on Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: You have two ticking problems: Nandi’s gunshot wound will turn septic within four days unless you pay an off-the-books surgeon (R1,500), and Brigadier Mokoena’s TRT squads are sweeping the district block by block.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: In your hands sits the evidence that links City Hall, SAPS Organized Crime, and the Abasanta Cartel. Your daily dice are ready on the table.
popt.opt_start_game.label: Step Up to the District Map (Begin Cycle 1)
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.title: Breach Fiduciary Escrow Server
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.desc: Slice into the private wealth-management server on the 28th floor to trace the Sovereign Pearl offshore shell trust.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.clean: Clean slice. You mirror the DIFC Dubai bearer-share certificates before the private security firewall reacts.
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.compromise: You pull half the registry, but a silent alarm flags your MAC address to the legal team (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_breach_ridge_server.failure: Biometric shutters slam down. You barely slip down the service stairwell as private tactical guards sweep the lobby.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.title: Press Tender Consultant in Sky-Bar
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.desc: Corner Councillor Ma-Sibi’s offshore tax attorney over single-malt scotch and demand retainer hush-money.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.clean: He slides a platinum casino chip and R1,100 cash across the marble table, promising to stall the contempt warrant.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.compromis: He pays R650 out of pocket to keep his name off the roll, though his bodyguard photographs your plates.
slot.slot_shakedown_consultant.failure: He laughs in your face and calls the Commission’s security clerk to report witness intimidation.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.title: Pull Black-Box GPS from Tanker #114
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.desc: Pry open the dashboard telemetry unit of an impounded municipal tanker to trace its midnight stops in the Midlands.
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.clean: With Bra Bheki’s marshals keeping watch, you extract the uncorrupted Howick highway coordinates (+2 Lab Telemetry).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.compromised: You rip the GPS module free, but a cartel spotter on the ridge logs your silhouette (+1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_extract_tanker_gps.failure: Booby-trapped ignition wiring sparks across your hands, drawing armed depot guards.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.title: Coordinate with Strike Committee (R400)
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.desc: Fund the township water-crisis marshals to set up community barricades that slow down cartel hit squads.
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.clean: Burning tyres and minibus blockades seal the northern access roads—Zuko’s gunmen are forced to retreat (-2 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.compromis: The strike marshals reroute traffic around your safehouse (-1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_rally_civic_marshals.failure: SAPS Nyalas disperse the picket line with stun grenades before the barricade can hold.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.title: File Section 205 Offshore Subpoena
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.desc: Work with Colonel van der Merwe’s evidence leaders to force standard charter banks to unmask Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.clean: Judge Khumalo signs the bench order. The bank’s compliance officer uploads the wire transfers within the hour (+2 Trust, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.compromi: Defense counsel files three urgent interdicts, but you secure the primary signatory page (+1 Trust).
slot.slot_subpoena_bank_records.failure: Mokoena’s counsel accuses you of fabricating evidence on the stand (+1 Contempt Warrant).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.title: Witness Protection Safe-Room Debrief (R300)
slot.slot_recess_debrief.desc: Grab coffee and clean bandages in the guarded Hawks chambers beneath Courtroom A to steady your nerves.
slot.slot_recess_debrief.clean: Constable Nandi—now walking on crutches—reviews your timeline over strong rooibos tea (+25% Composure, -1 Contempt).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.compromised: Two hours of uninterrupted sleep behind bulletproof glass restores your focus (+15% Composure).
slot.slot_recess_debrief.failure: Reporters bang on the chamber doors all afternoon, leaving you only marginally rested (+5% Composure).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.title: Breach Packhouse B Synthesis Vats
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.desc: Slip past the perimeter dogs to photograph the municipal water tankers pumping precursor into the citrus packhouse. Stage 6 kills the electric fence (+2).
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.clean: Under blackout cover you photograph the entire synthesis line and pocket R900 in bearer bonds from the foreman’s safe.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.compromis: You capture the batch serial numbers, but floodlights snap back on as Rottweilers hit the fence line.
slot.slot_infiltrate_packhouse.failure: Private mercenaries open fire with R5 rifles from the watchtower. You escape through the irrigation canal soaked in chemical runoff.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.title: [FINALE] Storm the Midlands Super-Lab
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.desc: Lead the township strike marshals or Hawks tactical team directly into Packhouse B before the evidence can be incinerated.
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.clean: You breach the packhouse gates and seize the master ledger—forcing Zuko and Mokoena into a desperate dash for Hangar 7!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.compromised: Through heavy gunfire you secure the synthesis vats as the syndicate convoy races toward King Shaka Airport!
slot.slot_act2_finale_citrus.failure: The packhouse erupts in flames, triggering the final confrontation at King Shaka Hangar 7!
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.title: Lock Gulfstream ZS-900 Avionics
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.desc: Override the hangar radar transponder to ground Zuko’s Dubai flight plan. Stage 6 blacks out tarmac radar (+2).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.clean: You inject a false engine-fire fault into ZS-900’s flight computer, delaying takeoff clearance (-1 Flight Countdown, -1 Hit Squad).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.compromis: Air Traffic Control holds the charter jet at the taxiway threshold (-1 Flight Countdown).
slot.slot_sabotage_transponder.failure: SAPS TRT snipers on the hangar roof spot your laser link across the wet tarmac.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.title: [FINALE] Intercept Flight ZS-900 at Hangar 7
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.desc: Drive onto the rain-swept apron as Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena board the Gulfstream.
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.clean: Your headlights cut across the Gulfstream’s nose wheel—blocking the taxiway for the final reckoning!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.compromised: You ram through the Hangar 7 perimeter barrier just as the jet turbines spool up!
slot.slot_act2_finale_tarmac.failure: Taking fire from Mokoena’s escort detail, you skid onto the apron as the boarding stairs begin to retract!
clock.cartel_hit_squad.desc: Zuko and Brigadier Mokoena have hired out-of-province contract gunmen to silence you before the Commission concludes.
clock.commission_subpoena.title: Contempt & Security Warrant
clock.commission_subpoena.desc: Compromised prosecutors within the Inquiry are building a warrant to detain you under State Security statutes.
clock.trace_offshore_trust.title: Trace Sovereign Pearl Trust
clock.trace_offshore_trust.desc: Cross-reference Umhlanga Ridge corporate registries and High Court subpoenas to unmask the Dubai beneficial owners.
clock.compile_ballistics_file.title: Synthesize Super-Lab Telemetry
clock.compile_ballistics_file.desc: Extract GPS route logs from impounded Northern Township water tankers to pinpoint the inland chemical synthesis estate.
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.title: Flight ZS-900 Charter Departure
clock.tarmac_extraction_countdown.desc: Countdown until Zuko Ndlovu, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena board the Dubai-bound Gulfstream at King Shaka Hangar 7.
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "Don't open the blinds, Sbu. Mokoena's unmarked Golf GTIs are circling Anton Lembede Street every twenty minutes. They didn't just kill Auditor Sithole at the Umgeni weighbridge—they were waiting for him with port transponders already scrubbed."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Everything Sithole died for is inside Docket #409 and that cracked handset. Tell me we aren't dying in this flat tonight."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Walk me through the N2 weighbridge ambush again. Who pulled the trigger?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Look at these weighbridge timestamps with me. Which tanker plates were ghosted?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "I traced the shell company. Ma-Sibi and Zuko own the tankers."
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Rest up, Nandi. Keep the deadbolt thrown while I work the street."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Two blue-light sedans boxed us in just past the Umgeni off-ramp. Brigadier Mokoena didn't even wear a balaclava. He stepped out in his pressed TRT fatigues, took one look at Sithole's briefcase, and told his corporal to burn the car."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "I rolled down the embankment into the storm drain with the original manila folder under my vest. If Sparks at Golden Dragon can crack Sithole's phone, Mokoena's own voice is on that cached voice note."
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "Let's go back over our options."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "I'll make sure that voice note sees daylight."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Here—plates ND-449-102 through 118. They billed City Hall for forty-two million Rand to deliver drinking water to KwaMashu during the drought, but look at the diesel toll tags. They never turned north."
"Every single tanker drove straight into Pier 2 Cold Storage at 01:30 AM. They're hauling Zuko Ndlovu's chemical precursors under municipal water livery."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "That saves me hours of ledger cross-checking. Hold tight."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... sixty percent Abasanta Maritime, forty percent Ma-Sibi's family trust. You actually nailed it, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Get this to Colonel van der Merwe in the Old Archive Basement—or burn Berth 14 to the waterline yourself. Either way, they don't get away clean."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "Stay off your feet. We're entering the endgame."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Queen Street Taxi Boss • Syndicate Fixer
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, the ex-Hawk walks into Queen Street while Mokoena's TRT boys are turning over every second minibus at Warwick Junction. You've got brass, Sbu, I'll give you that."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Nothing moves through the CBD without my drivers seeing it first—not SAPS Nyalas, and definitely not those shiny municipal water tankers running heavy at two in the morning."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "What are your night-shift drivers saying about the municipal tankers?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Your rank marshals owe me from the Berea route truce. Scrub my plates from Mokoena's spotters."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "The Queen Street alliance stands together. Can the rank float me operation cash?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Keep your headlights low, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Listen carefully. Those tankers have City Hall decals on the doors, yeah? But my boys who run the Umbilo graveyard shift say the tyres are Squatting under chemical drum weight, and Abasanta gunmen ride shotgun in Golf R sedans."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "meanwhile our mothers in KwaMashu queue with plastic buckets at dry standpipes. Councillor Ma-Sibi is selling out her own wards."
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Good intel. Let's talk about something else."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "You never forgot how the street works, Sbu. Done. Three of my Quantums just boxed in the SAPS camera van on Monty Naicker Road. You've got breathing room."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Respect, Bra Bheki."
"Take this from the route association war-chest. Buy diesel, bribe a clerk, or get Nandi patched up. Just make sure Mokoena bleeds for choking our streets."
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "It'll go straight into breaking their convoy."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Well, well. Look what the monsoon washed into my charge office. You're suspended from the Hawks, Sbu—walking in here takes either a death wish or a very expensive lawyer."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Where is Constable Nandi, and where is the municipal auditor's briefcase?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "I'm just checking the public charge sheet, Brigadier. Nervous about something on the N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Internal Affairs in Pretoria already has a blind copy of Docket #409. Call off your sweep or we both burn."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "I have your voice on tape ordering the Umgeni hit, Titus. Pay me to misplace the copy."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Goodnight, Brigadier. Watch your step in the blackout."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "Durban runs on order, Sbu. Zuko keeps the docks quiet, Ma-Sibi keeps the lights on at City Hall, and my Task Force keeps the peace. Mandla Sithole thought a spreadsheet could stop a freight train."
"Hand Nandi over before midnight on Day 4, or my men won't bother knocking on your Mercury Arcade door."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Hold that thought, Titus."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Stand down Car 4 and Car 7 from the Victoria Embankment sector. You always knew how to play bureaucratic chess, Sbu. Enjoy the extra twenty-four hours—it won't save you when Berth 14 clears."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "So the idealistic Hawk finally learned the price of meat in eThekwini. Take this seized cash from the locker. Keep that audio file off Colonel van der Merwe's desk, and maybe Zuko lets you live to see next week."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "We'll see how long your credit holds."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Close the door, darling, the humidity ruins the mahogany. Everybody in this city complains when the grid drops to Stage 6, yet nobody asks who pays for coalition politics."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "You've been sniffing around Procurement Registry B. Tell me what a disgraced investigator wants with emergency water infrastructure."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Why does Sub-Station 14 always trip right when Pier 2 unloads at midnight?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Forty percent of Zululand Aqua-Logistics belongs to your family trust, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Your clerk left the Sub-Station 14 override schedule on the fax machine. I'm copying the port blackout window."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Enjoy the air-conditioning while it lasts, Councillor."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Load shedding is a tragedy, Sbu—unless you know which breaker to pull and when. When Stage 6 hits the Point Waterfront, Transnet's automated cameras go blind for four hours."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Friends of City Hall never sit in the dark. Enemies find their safehouses raided before the streetlights come back on."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "A convenient arrangement."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "Mandla Sithole was a brilliant accountant with zero survival instinct. You, on the other hand, understand leverage."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Here is a five-hundred Rand retainer from the discretionary ward fund. Keep my trust's name out of the newspapers, and my office can even manipulate the Eskom grid when you need a blackout."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "I'll pocket the retainer. We'll see about the newspapers."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Competent staff are impossible to find in this municipality. Fine—take the telecoms routing sheet. You'll find it leads straight back to Zuko's crane at Berth 14 anyway."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Much obliged, Councillor."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Mind the tripwire by the umbrella stand, Sbu! Stage 4 voltage spikes just fried two of my oscilloscopes, and Mokoena's cyber-crime goons have been pinging every cell tower between Grey Street and the harbour."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "You brought me Mandla Sithole's GraphemeOS brick? That handset has an Abasanta remote-wipe daemon sitting on the baseband chip."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "What's on the auditor's phone that has Zuko and Mokoena so terrified?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Let's bridge the JTAG pins inside a Faraday cage before the baseband pings the tower."
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Put a pot of Ethiopian espresso on the gas burner and sweep my burner phone for SAPS IMSI-catchers."
dialogue_resp.sparks_exit.label: "Keep the Faraday cage sealed, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "Sithole wasn't just an accountant—he planted a directional mic inside Pier 2 Cold Storage. Before they rammed his car on the N2, his phone cached a forty-eight-second voice note and the container manifest for MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Watch out for Stage 6 blackouts, though. Unless you run your safehouse diesel generator, my main decryption rig loses grid power."
dialogue_resp.sparks_lore_back.label: "Good to know. Let's check the bench."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Look at that voltage timing—we bypassed the first biometric lock without tripping the Abasanta wipe daemon. One more clean pass on the bench and this drive is yours."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "Nice soldering, Sparks."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Yup, Central Precinct had a stingray tower locked onto your old SIM serial. I've rotated your baseband MAC address to look like a municipal parking meter. Drink up!"
dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "That hits the spot."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Look out at the channel, Sbu. Sixty ships waiting at anchor, three thousand containers a day, and Pretoria thinks a piece of paper signed by a magistrate governs this harbour."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "I built Abasanta Logistics from a single cold-storage shed. Now you stand on my catwalk with a dead auditor's ledger. Are you here to play hero, or are you here to understand supply and demand?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_philosophy.label: "You're poisoning township water routes to haul chemical precursors, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_present_manifest.labe: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Container MSCU-908114 is flagged. Cut me in on the logistics retainer or the Hawks board MV Southern Cross."
dialogue_resp.zuko_street_spot.label: [STREET >= 2] "Your Berth 14 crane guards just rotated shifts. I've already clocked the blind spot by the fuel valves."
dialogue_resp.zuko_exit.label: "We'll settle this when the midnight convoy rolls, Zuko."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "City Hall stole the water budget ten years before I ever leased a tanker, Sbu. I simply rented their empty trucks. In this country, infrastructure belongs to whoever maintains the diesel and pays the guards."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "Mokoena is a blunt instrument, and Ma-Sibi is a parasite. Help me clear Berth 14 tonight, and you'll never scrape for rent in Mercury Arcade again."
dialogue_resp.zuko_vision_back.label: "Every kingpin thinks he's a philosopher."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Smart man. The Hawks paid you peanuts and threw you to the wolves when you got too close to the truth. Consider this your first dividend from Berth 14. When midnight comes, make sure that convoy rolls."
dialogue_resp.zuko_deal_back.label: "We'll see what midnight brings."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "No wonder Mokoena's hit squad missed you on the N2. You move like dockyard smoke. Tell Titus I called off his harbour patrol dogs for tonight—if we're going to test each other, let's do it without amateurs in the way."
dialogue_resp.zuko_respect_back.label: "Until midnight at Berth 14."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "You made it past the magistrate court cameras, Sbu. Good. Half of Provincial Headquarters is on Mokoena's payroll, which is why I moved my task force down here with the 1980s microfiche machines."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "You look like hell, my boy—and I hear Constable Nandi took a round on the N2. Tell me you brought something that can survive a High Court judge."
dialogue_resp.vdm_ask_hawks.label: "Why haven't the Hawks arrested Mokoena and Ma-Sibi already, Colonel?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_present_both.label: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Listen to this audio file, Colonel. Mokoena ordered the N2 hit himself."
dialogue_resp.vdm_exit.label: "Keep the blast door bolted, Colonel. I'm almost ready."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Because every time I draft a warrant Upstairs, someone in the Ministry tips off City Hall within fifteen minutes. Without both the financial ledger AND the Berth 14 audio, the prosecutor will throw the case out before breakfast."
"If we transmit the full package straight to The Daily Veld newsroom while locking down witness protection for Nandi, they can't bury it."
dialogue_resp.vdm_politics_back.label: "Then we bypass Upstairs completely."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Good God... 'intercept his sedan before the Umgeni off-ramp and burn the briefcase.' That's Titus Mokoena's voice, crystal clear."
"I'm putting your vehicle on our federal diplomatic registry right now to scrub your Precinct Heat. Stay alive until we broadcast this, Sbu."
dialogue_resp.vdm_audio_back.label: "Thank you, Colonel."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "The air is cleaner up here on the Ridge, isn't it, Sbu? Down in the CBD they're holding their little Judicial Commission of Inquiry, pretending a retired judge can unwind twenty years of municipal patronage."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "My suitcases are already at King Shaka Hangar 7. Why are you climbing my glass tower when the storm is almost over?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "What is Sovereign Pearl Holdings, and why is a Gulfstream fuelled at Hangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Your fiduciary clerk forgot to wipe the Dubai SWIFT mirror on the 28th-floor server."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "I have the beneficial ownership schedule, Ma-Sibi. Buy your seat off my charge sheet."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "Don't board that Gulfstream yet, Councillor."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Every smart politician in KwaZulu-Natal knows the Rand is for spending and the Dirham is for keeping. Sovereign Pearl holds the real estate in Dubai, the citrus estate in the Midlands, and the charter jet at Hangar 7."
"Zuko owns forty-five percent, I hold thirty, and Titus Mokoena holds twenty-five for keeping the guns pointed away from us."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "A neat three-way split."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "You hacked the escrow terminal? You really are relentless. Fine—the prosecutors shepherding that Contempt Warrant against you answer to my coalition whip. I'll tell them to slow-walk your arrest file."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Smart move."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "Take it. Focus your wrath on Zuko's Midlands super-lab or Mokoena's hitmen—leave an old woman to her retirement villa on the Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "We'll see who makes the flight."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Look at these tankers we seized last night, Sbu! False baffles welded inside the drums—dry as bone in the water compartment, and chemical precursor residue in the hidden core."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "The people in the northern wards are done waiting for High Court commissions. My drivers have locked down the depot, and Mokoena's out-of-province izinkabi hitmen are prowling the ridge roads looking for you."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "Did the impounded tankers still have their dash-mount GPS transponders intact?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "Let's pull the GPS flash chips from Lead Tanker #14 right now and set up citizen spotters against the hit squad."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Hold the depot gates, Bra Bheki. We're taking the fight to their estate."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Every single one of them! Between 1:00 AM and 4:00 AM, instead of pumping water from the reservoir, these trucks climbed the N3 inland to a hydroponic citrus estate near the Howick spur."
"Synthesize that telemetry data, Sbu, and you'll have the exact coordinates of Zuko's inland super-lab."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "That's the missing link between the harbour and the airport."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Here's the flash module from Tanker #14! And don't worry about those contract gunmen from Joburg—any strange sedan entering the northern corridor gets boxed in by forty Quantums before they can load a magazine."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Welcome to the Commission of Inquiry, Sbu. Berth 14 blew the lid off the harbour, so now the syndicate is fighting us with silk-robed advocates and State Security gag orders."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Worse still, we intercepted flight-plan telemetry from King Shaka International. Flight ZS-900—a private Gulfstream—is fuelled at Hangar 7 to extract Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena to Dubai."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_plan.label: "What do we need to ground Flight ZS-900 and finish them for good?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_dockets.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Let's file an emergency counter-affidavit right now to quash the Contempt Warrant and subpoena the Ridge escrow records."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Keep the Commission in session, Colonel. I'm going hunting."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Two supreme exhibits: First, the Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed from the Ridge Penthouses proving all three of them co-own the syndicate. Second, the Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry from the northern water tankers."
"Unlock either breakthrough to reveal the Citrus Estate and King Shaka Hangar 7—or secure both if you want to put every last one of them in chains on the tarmac."
dialogue_resp.vdm_briefing_back.label: "Understood, Colonel."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Brilliant statutory citation, Sbu. That ties the hands of Ma-Sibi's compromised prosecutors for another forty-eight hours and forces the Ridge corporate secretary to open the DIFC ledger."
dialogue_resp.vdm_motion_back.label: "Let's press the advantage."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "You followed the water tankers all the way up the escarpment, Sbu. Impressive. Most men stop once they reach the beachside penthouses in Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Look around Packhouse B. Valencia oranges on the top conveyor, ninety-nine percent pure export crystal in the false crates below, bound straight for King Shaka Cargo Apron. And you're standing in the middle of my harvest."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_why.label: "You're evacuating to Dubai on Flight ZS-900 tonight. Is the Architect running scared?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Every batch number and tanker route is already mirrored off-site. Call off your izinkabi hit squad and pay the transition tax."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_exit.label: "See you on the tarmac at Hangar 7, Zuko."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Scared? No, Sbu—restructuring. The Commission of Inquiry needs a circus, so Ma-Sibi and Mokoena are panicking. Meanwhile, the infrastructure we built here prints twenty million Euro a month."
"When you reach Hangar 7 tonight, you'll have a choice: arrest us for a state that will replace us by Tuesday, burn the estate with Bra Bheki's mob, or take the keys to the throne yourself."
dialogue_resp.zuko_manifesto_back.label: "We'll make that choice at Hangar 7."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "The Gauteng shooters are standing down. You've earned a seat at the table, Sbu. Take this from the packhouse safe—and think very carefully before you let Colonel van der Merwe put handcuffs on the future."
dialogue_resp.zuko_truce_back.label: "I'll see you at the airport."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "End of the runway, Sbu! The Gulfstream engines are warm, diplomatic clearance is filed, and the pallet jacks are loading the last crates into the hold."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "You survived the N2, you survived Pier 2, and you survived my hit squad. Speak your piece before the boarding stairs retract!"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "If you climb those stairs, Titus, you're a fugitive for the rest of your life."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Half your TRT sergeants aren't on that plane, Titus. I just told them you're leaving them to take the fall at the Commission."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Time to finish this on the tarmac."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Fugitive? With twenty-five percent of Sovereign Pearl Holdings in a Dubai vault, they'll call me an international security consultant! Either get out of the way of the nosewheel, or make your final play right here!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Where are Unit 3 and Unit 5 going?! Damn you, Sbu—you turned my own sergeants against the perimeter! Every man for himself on the tarmac!"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "The tarmac is open. Let's end this."
