ending.ending_vigilante.pathLabel: THE VIGILANTE PATH // BLOOD ON THE BREAKWATER
ending.ending_vigilante.p1: When Stage 6 kills the harbour floodlights at midnight, Bra Bheki’s minibus convoy cuts its headlights and blocks the Pier 2 weighbridge. Fifteen heavily armed izinkabi step out from behind the rusting container stacks just as Brigadier Mokoena’s unmarked TRT vans escort the municipal water tankers onto Berth 14.
ending.ending_vigilante.p2: The firefight echoes across the Natal Port Channel for twenty minutes. Punctured chemical drums spill across the wet asphalt, catching a tracer round and sending a wall of orange flame forty metres into the humid night sky.
ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer cash, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift1.title: Abasanta Cartel Crippled
ending.ending_vigilante.shift1.summary: R80 million in Mexican chemical precursors burn on the quay. Zuko Ndlovu retreats to his inland citrus estates, vowing to purge the port security directorate.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift2.title: Queen Street Ascendant
ending.ending_vigilante.shift2.summary: Bra Bheki’s syndicate seizes control of the Umgeni transport corridor, forcing City Hall to pay his 30% forum cut on every tanker truck.
ending.ending_vigilante.shift3.title: The Ghost of Mercury Arcade
ending.ending_vigilante.shift3.summary: With R450,000 in stolen cartel cash funding your off-grid clinic and armoury, you become the CBD’s untouchable shadow fixer.
ending.ending_whistleblower.pathLabel: THE WHISTLEBLOWER PATH // TRUTH IN THE DARK
ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Archive Basement. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift1.title: City Hall in Freefall
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift1.summa: National Treasury freezes the R400m water-tanker contract by noon. Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff is arrested at King Shaka International Airport trying to board a flight to Dubai.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift2.title: SAPS Internal Purge
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift2.summa: IPID and the Hawks raid Central Precinct’s 13th Floor. Brigadier Mokoena goes underground with a rogue detachment of loyal TRT officers.
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift3.title: Badge Restored, Target Painted
ending.ending_whistleblower.shift3.summa: Colonel van der Merwe reinstates your Warrant Officer credentials—but Abasanta’s Chemical Ghost hitmen have just placed a R5 million bounty on your badge.
ending.ending_kingpin.pathLabel: THE KINGPIN PATH // THE GLASS HOUSE COMPACT
ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Docket #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift1.title: The Syndicate Consolidates
ending.ending_kingpin.shift1.summary: The Berth 14 precursor shipment rolls through the N2 weighbridge untouched under blue-light escort. The methamphetamine super-labs double their output.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift2.title: Hawks Task Force Shuttered
ending.ending_kingpin.shift2.summary: Without Docket #409, Colonel van der Merwe’s inquiry collapses for lack of evidence. His basement unit is reassigned to rural stock-theft duty.
ending.ending_kingpin.shift3.title: The New Fixer-General
ending.ending_kingpin.shift3.summary: You move out of the Mercury Arcade flat into a Ridge penthouse—wealthy, reinstated, and permanently chained to Zuko Ndlovu’s ledger.
ending.ending_captured.pathLabel: SYSTEMIC FAILURE // SWALLOWED BY THE GRID
ending.ending_captured.p1: Exhausted, broke, and boxed in by Operation Shanela roadblocks, your trail finally runs out in the rain-swept alleys behind Queen Street. When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.
ending.ending_captured.p2: Brigadier Mokoena doesn’t read you your rights. He pulls Docket #409 and the dead auditor’s phone from your coat pocket, checks the seal, and nods to Sergeant Dlamini.
ending.ending_captured.p3: By the time the morning commuters crowd the taxi rank, theMercury Arcade flat has been scrubbed clean, and another anonymous dossier has vanished into the furnace of eThekwini-Gold.
ending.ending_captured.shift1.title: State Capture Unchecked
ending.ending_captured.shift1.summary: Ma-Sibi wins the municipal coalition vote unopposed, expanding the emergency water-tanker contracts by another R600 million.
ending.ending_captured.shift2.title: Docket #409 Erased
ending.ending_captured.shift2.summary: The N2 Cash-in-Transit massacre is officially closed as an unsolved syndicate hijacking.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena face 142 counts of racketeering, treasonous sabotage, and murder before a special High Court tribunal.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Precinct.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the syndicate’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their cartel protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized docket pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the harbour cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.pathLabel: ACT 2 FAILURE // REDACTED FROM THE RECORD
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original ledger and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift1.title: Clean Getaway
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift1.summa: Zuko Ndlovu and Ma-Sibi relocate their logistics empire to Dubai while retaining silent proxies inside City Hall.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift2.title: Case Closed
ending.ending_act2_vanished.shift2.summa: Without the Sovereign Pearl deed or Midlands telemetry, the High Court dismisses all remaining charges.
prologue.log.bolt_deadlocks: You haul Nandi inside and bolt the deadlocks as thunder shakes the arcade glass.
prologue.log.fake_disaster: You spot it immediately: the tender bypassed provincial treasury using a Fake Disaster Declaration signature.

prologue.log.dead_auditor_phone: "The dead auditor’s phone," she whispers. "I rolled down the storm embankment into the sugarcane when the second TRT van arrived."
prologue.log.kill_radio: You pop the casing off her Tetraburst radio and drop the GPS chip into a glass of gin before dragging her inside.
prologue.log.clear_alley: You scan the rain-swept roofline—no laser sights or unmarked Golfs yet—and pull her onto the sofa.

tutorial.step1.zone: Daily Action Dice, Composure & Tactical Advisor
tutorial.step1.bullet1: Click any die in the bottom tray to hold it—every Action Slot immediately previews your exact modified total (Green 6+, Amber 4–5, Red 1–3).
tutorial.step1.bullet2: Not sure what to do next? Follow the "Tactical Advisor" in the Left Panel or look for pulsing "★ Recommended" badges on map nodes and action slots.
tutorial.step1.bullet3: When you run out of dice for the day, click "End Cycle / Sleep →" to advance to the next morning.
tutorial.step2.bullet1: Final Roll = Die Face + Stat Modifier + Stage 6 Bonus + Gear/Tactical Buffs.
tutorial.step2.bullet2: 6 or higher (Green — Clean Success): Advances Investigation Clocks by +2 segments or pays maximum Rands with zero trace.
tutorial.step2.bullet3: 4 or 5 (Amber — Compromised Success): Advances clocks by +1 segment or pays cash, but costs minor Composure.
tutorial.step2.bullet4: 1 to 3 (Red — Failure / Blowback): Zero progress, Composure loss, and adds Precinct Heat.

mission.faq_q1_title: 1. What is a "Cycle" and how many are there?
mission.faq_q1_body: A Cycle is 1 In-Game Day (a 24-hour shift). There is no arbitrary maximum like 50 or 100 days. Instead, you are racing against Ticking Threat Clocks (like Brigadier Mokoena's Sweep at 6 segments). An average investigation takes 3 to 6 cycles for Act 1 and 4 to 8 cycles for Act 2.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. How many dice do I get? Do I throw dice at every venue?
mission.faq_q2_body: Each morning, you roll 3 to 5 dice TOTAL for the whole city based on your Composure (80%+ = 5 dice, 40–79% = 4 dice, <40% = 3 dice). You do NOT throw dice at every venue! You choose 3 to 5 key actions across the map to invest your daily effort into.
mission.faq_q3_title: 3. What happens when I click "End Cycle / Sleep"?
mission.faq_q3_body:
Clicking End Cycle ends your shift and advances to the next morning:
• Threat Clocks advance (+1 segment on active red clocks).
• Load Shedding rotates (Stage 2 → 4 → 6 → 2).

intro.pitch_story2: Strategic destruction of Eskom power generation to force emergency open-cycle gas turbine diesel tenders, bankrolled by private security oligarchs and corrupt cabinet insiders. Disgraced SIU investigator Kagiso "Bra K" Molefe must penetrate Johannesburg's deepest mine shafts and Sandton penthouses before the grid collapses.
intro.pitch_story3: Unregistered seabed diamond-dredging concessions, cross-border arms drops, and private naval mercenaries laundering energy cash into international conflict stones across the fog-shrouded Atlantic coastline of Port Nolloth and the Richtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: A shadow alliance of provincial police generals, unified Cape Flats gang cartels, and historic Winelands oligarchs arming a private security army to control the night economy and export docks. Former Anti-Gang Unit detective Leila Hendricks investigates from Camps Bay to the Stellenbosch cellars.
intro.pitch_story5: Total Stage 8 Black-Sky Grid Collapse across all nine provinces. The United Hawks Taskforce unifies the four regional forensic keystones to storm the Sovereign Octagon summit in the Drakensberg before democracy is permanently dissolved.
